act.long_title: An Act to define and amend the law relating to Promissory Notes, Bills of Exchange and Cheques.

licence: Published with commentary and other original matter under s.52(1)(q)(ii), Copyright Act 1957.

section.heading: Cheque crossed generally
section.html: Where a cheque bears across its face an addition of the words "and company" or any abbreviation thereof, between two parallel transverse lines, or of two parallel transverse lines simply, either with or without the words "not negotiable," that addition shall be deemed a crossing, and the cheque shall be deemed to be crossed generally
